BM25_Baseline.name: Pure BM25 Baseline
BM25_Baseline.description: Standard sparse lexical retrieval over raw files without semantic vectors, graph prior, workflow routing, or skeleton compression.

RepoMap_Baseline.name: Official Aider-Style RepoMap Reference
RepoMap_Baseline.description: Graph PageRank over Python symbols and call hierarchy (ARB v2 official frozen benchmark).

Candidate_A.name: Static Lexical-plus-Semantic Hybrid (Full Files Only)
Candidate_A.description: Static equal fusion of BM25, subword character n-grams, and repository PageRank graph centrality. No heuristic router; full files only (no skeleton compression).
Candidate_A.expected_behavior: Robust ranking across diverse tasks (+8% MRR over BM25), but bounded context packing at 8k tokens.

Candidate_B.name: Candidate A + Structural Skeleton Compression
Candidate_B.description: Candidate A combined with AST-based structural skeleton compression during token-budget packing.
Candidate_B.expected_behavior: Identical ranking order to Candidate A (ranking orthogonal), with +24% higher budgeted context yield (BCY@8k).

Candidate_C.name: Candidate B + Documentation-Distractor Filtering
Candidate_C.description: Candidate B with 0.5x penalty on documentation paths (docs/, doc/, *.md, *.rst) to prevent doc file distraction on conversational code queries.
Candidate_C.expected_behavior: Suppresses documentation false positives, boosting comment2context retrieval without regressing code tasks.

Candidate_D.name: Candidate C + Relevance-Aware Graph Diffusion
Candidate_D.description: Candidate C augmented with 1-hop relevance diffusion along the file import/call graph from top lexical/semantic hits.
Candidate_D.expected_behavior: Propagates relevance to immediate structural caller/callee files, expanding recall on multi-file dependencies.

Candidate_E.name: Candidate D + Multilingual Polyglot Symbol Extraction
Candidate_E.description: Candidate D augmented with regex-based polyglot symbol and import extraction for non-Python languages (Rust, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript).
Candidate_E.expected_behavior: Provides structural symbols, imports, and graph connectivity for polyglot codebases.

notes: Code implementation committed to research-program. Candidates will remain completely unmodified during independent evaluation.
